title: Israeli Forces Kill Rania Salama Saad in Al-Mawasi, Rafah, Amid Wider Barrage of Ceasefire Violations
detail: Israeli soldiers shot and killed Rania Salama Saad in the al-Mawasi area of Rafah, southern Gaza, in violation reports published September 25, 2026. Overnight into early Friday, Israeli forces shelled a displaced-persons' tent in the al-Sawarha area of al-Zawayda, central Gaza, wounding several, while a drone fired two additional missiles into the same area and armored vehicles opened heavy fire north and northeast of the Bureij refugee camp. A separate Israeli bombardment of a vehicle near the American Hospital in al-Zawayda killed one more, unidentified, Palestinian, and five more Palestinians were wounded, one critically, near Haifa School in Khan Younis. The Gaza Health Ministry's 24-hour tally put the toll at five killed and 35 wounded, bringing the ceasefire-period total since October 11, 2025 to 1,408 killed and 4,916 wounded, with 834 bodies recovered from rubble.

media.caption: Continued Israeli ceasefire violations across Gaza, late Sep 2026
